iam_gap.SIGN_CONVENTION: delta_pct = (IAM published offer − projected ISZE retail) / projected ISZE retail. POSITIVE means ISZE is CHEAPER at retail than the named IAM offer (competitive, good). NEGATIVE means ISZE sits ABOVE that offer at retail (exposed). Colour positive green, negative red.

IBX is BELGIUM / sold-to 90 — included when it qualifies. Complete-CY billed euros (credits out) stamp book size; sales lines have no vehicle segment so SKU-level LCV billed cannot be split. Turkey and MIDI are not ISZE distributors and are not in the set. UMI 1797 is never blended with UTI 1799.
